patches.old: It is exactly the winding in \(P3F.13.2\), with the same \(W/\exp(\zeta_2)\) sign conversion.
patches.new: For \(\rho=|\rho|e^{2\pi i\theta}\), the full iterate acts on the angular coordinate \(u=W/|W|\) by \(u\mapsto e^{-24\pi i\theta}u\). In \(P3F.13.2\), the angular coordinate \(u'=\exp(2\pi i\zeta_2)/|\exp(2\pi i\zeta_2)|\) has the same transition. The map \((\theta,u)\mapsto(\theta,u)\) between these angular trivializations commutes with that transition and therefore identifies the two clutched circle bundles.
patches.reason: Exact circle-bundle comparison supplied by corrections_audit: common transition exp(-24 pi i theta), identity in angular trivializations. Does not assert an unverified holomorphic W-to-zeta coordinate identity. Apply after F10–24 notation patches.
